name: Memory Hooks & Organizational Learning
objectives: Verify pre-run hydrate hook injects relevant memory into agent runtime context
Verify post-run capture hook extracts new facts from agent outputs and writes them
Verify manual memory capture registers new knowledge logs successfully
Verify successful runs automatically capture playbooks when quality exceeds threshold
Verify repeated blockers and failure logs generate proposed agent config updates
Verify learning system proposes updates to agent skills and templates
Verify hook operations save detailed provenance logs to the audit trail
Verify memory hydrate hooks reject unauthorized cross-tenant read access
Verify memory capture hooks reject unauthorized cross-tenant write access
Ensure verifier regression chain rolls back to 5.1A
